F1.summary: Repeated own revoke/cancel (and every other outcome) returned before the post-lock DB clock / current-caller expiry check.
F1.fix: guard.ts lockedClock(tx, admission): DB clock read after the command's LAST row lock, null when the caller's own current token (captured at admission) has expired. approve/reject/revoke/cancel/reserve now acquire all row locks first (lock order unchanged: fence → request → approval; reserve also reads the attempt), call lockedClock, and return ACTION_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED (no audit, no mutation) before ANY outcome: stored REVOKED/CANCELLED replay, APPROVED replay, authorized refusal audit, guarded-loss commit, decision or reservation. Replaced dbClock/callerExpired.
F1.preserved: valid terminal and approval replays return the identical stored result with no mutation/audit/renewal and recapture no epoch/snapshot; signer/requester identity checks and their codes unchanged; no stored-intent guard is applied to terminal history
F1.behaviourNoteForReview: an expired caller no longer triggers the commit of a detected stored-intent loss (it is committed by the next fresh caller); refusals by an expired caller write no refusal audit row
tests: tests/pg/action-guard.pg.test.ts "RC1-F1: terminal replays (own revoke, own cancel) …": revoke waiting on the request row and on the approval row; cancel of a pending request (no decision row) on the request row and of an approved request on its revoked decision row; valid replay before; ACTION_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED with request/approval rows, client and workspace audit counts and attempts unchanged; identical valid replay after the token is restored (epoch moved)

tests/pg/action-guard.pg.test.ts "RC1-F1: the same boundary precedes every other outcome …": APPROVED replay and reservation waiting on the approval row; another signer's revoke and another requester's cancel (valid refusals first, then no refusal audit when expired)

F2.summary: clientAudit (and the security-denial wrapper) mapped every exception, including a real 40P01 deadlock of the audit INSERT, to ACTION_AUDIT_FAILED.
F2.fix: authority.ts auditFailure(error): isDbConflict (40P01/40001, Prisma P2034) → fixed ACTION_DB_CONFLICT, anything else → ACTION_AUDIT_FAILED; used by clientAudit and the securityDenial wrapper. Fixed codes only (no raw message/SQL/body), no retry; transaction rollback unchanged.
tests: tests/pg/action-reserve.pg.test.ts "RC1-F2: a deadlock at the reservation audit INSERT …": real PG deadlock, the reservation proved waiting on the AuditEvent relation lock while holding the fence, owner then requests the fence row; ACTION_DB_CONFLICT; request/approval APPROVED, consumedAt null, 0 attempts, audit count unchanged, no permit; same for a scope denial deadlocked at its SecurityAuditEvent INSERT (no denial row); an explicit new call then reserves

tests/pg/action-reserve.pg.test.ts "RC1-F2: genuine audit-storage failures stay ACTION_AUDIT_FAILED …": trigger-raised denial-audit failure → ACTION_AUDIT_FAILED with no row, then normal PERMISSION_DENIED with one row; the existing reservation-audit failure test is retained
